title: Diagonally gauged anomaly-free 6D supergravities and their vacua
summary: We describe a bounded search for local and global anomaly-free six-dimensional $(1,0)$ models with tensor number $T=1$ and gauge group containing a diagonal abelian factor $U(1)_{R+}$. The abelian factor is the diagonal combination of the usual gauged $U(1)_R$ and a $U(1)\subset Sp(n_H)$ acting on hypermultiplets. We have searched for locally and globally anomaly-free $G_1\times U(1)_{R+}$ and $G_1\times G_2\times U(1)_{R+}$ models, subject to restrictions on the ranks of the simple factors and on the maximal charges carried by matter.
